question: Should this Wave 2+ dashboard umbrella remain the canonical product roadmap, or should maintainers close it and rely only on the narrower child issues?
rationale: The requested work is broad, partly aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, and partly constrained by plugin/ClawHub/security guardrails; automation cannot safely decide which dashboard capabilities should be bundled, external, deferred, or rejected.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap
options.body: Leave this umbrella open for maintainer planning while reviewing each child issue or PR on its own product, security, and plugin-boundary merits.

options.title: Close In Favor Of Children
options.body: Close this umbrella and let the linked child issues be the only canonical units of work if maintainers do not want contributor-authored roadmap trackers.

options.title: Narrow To Core Gaps Only
options.body: Edit or supersede the umbrella so it tracks only missing core/plugin API seams, with optional widgets and skills routed to ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap
recommendation.body: Leave this umbrella open for maintainer planning while reviewing each child issue or PR on its own product, security, and plugin-boundary merits.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current Control UI plugin-tab seam and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether a dashboard roadmap belongs in this repository.
